rationale: Sowing was the register's most-flagged weak family (5 of 56 games against a far larger real-world literature) and is the family Murray's newly-unlocked text unlocks best (congklak, ayoayo, gebeta, hus, mefuvha all draw directly on Murray passages plus source_verification.json citations). Duodecim scripta fills a genuine Roman-race-game gap Murray documents in detail but which had no shipped entry. Morra fills the boardless family and is one of the best-attested living games in the literature (continuous record from ancient Rome as micatio to the present).
